title: Coding-OS Skill Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter contract for core/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and templates/<stack>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Validated by cli/skill_registry.py at load time.

name.description: lowercase identifier (kebab-case preferred, snake_case tolerated) — must equal the parent directory name.

description.description: One paragraph (or scalar) describing when to invoke this skill. Triggers Claude's auto-load heuristic — keywords matter.

tier.description: Abstraction level. methodology=cognitive patterns; workflow=task/repo lifecycle; exploration=read-only investigation; quality=generic code quality; layer=per-architectural-layer patterns; cross-cutting=concerns spanning layers; stack=framework-specific; infra=host/ops/container tooling; architecture=data-store/query design.

domain.description: Problem area(s) the skill addresses. Use 'universal' alone when the skill applies to all code; otherwise list specific domains.

globs.description: Optional glob pattern. When set, the skill should auto-load on Write/Edit of matching paths (enforce-skill.sh hook).

context.description: How the skill prompt is composed. 'fork' = replace; 'extend' = append. Defaults to 'fork'.

depends_on.description: Other skills (by name) that must be loaded before this one.
